items.statement: Pt substitution weakens molecular hydrogen adsorption and lowers the HMF parallel-to-tilted configurational barrier in the reported model comparison.
items.expected: The conclusion is supported by both H2 energies and both validated barriers, with the model and limitations stated.

items.statement: The result is an electronic-energy comparison on idealized slabs and does not by itself prove experimental selectivity or finite-temperature kinetics.
items.expected: Limitations identify idealized slab geometry, incomplete author settings and the distinction between energetic support and catalytic-rate proof.
